name: Abdiel voice style
purpose: A durable writing reference for Abdiel's LinkedIn, Instagram, portfolio, and personal-brand content.
source_priority: Abdiel's newest direct corrections and approved wording
Observed post metrics and audience response

core_voice.register: Conversational Indonesian with natural English technical and professional terms.
core_voice.pronouns: Preserve gue or gw according to the surrounding source material. Do not formalize automatically.
rhythm: Prefer one longer spoken sentence that carries context, detail, and tension together.
Use paragraph breaks to control pacing.
Use short standalone sentences only after the narrative has earned the emphasis.
Avoid stacking short dramatic fragments as a synthetic LinkedIn hook.
Do not force every sentence into polished copywriting symmetry.

approved_learning_from_2026_07_29.user_correction: The opening 'M1-A selesai. Dashboard hidup. 71 produk masuk HITL.' felt too cliche and too engineered as a LinkedIn trailer.
approved_learning_from_2026_07_29.approved_direction: Keep reverse chronology, but express it as a natural conversational sentence with the achievement and doubt living inside the same breath.
approved_learning_from_2026_07_29.approved_example: Setelah hampir enam bulan, milestone yang kami pegang bareng client dari Prancis akhirnya diterima dan semua hasil implementasinya sudah gue handover ke developer berikutnya, tapi kalau project yang sama datang lagi besok, gue nggak akan mulai dari codebase.
approved_learning_from_2026_07_29.approved_following_paragraph: Awalnya gue masuk ke project ini sebagai pengalaman pertama gue kerja lebih dekat dengan global market. Timeline awalnya maksimal tiga bulan. Gue belum tahu kalau bagian tersulitnya bukan bikin modelnya jalan, tapi memastikan semua orang sedang membicarakan input, output, dan definisi “selesai” yang sama.

narrative_principles: Start from the personal truth of the project, not from a content formula.
Let technical detail prove why the personal change happened.
Acknowledge Abdiel's own mistaken assumptions or process responsibility when true.
Do not manufacture a single cinematic epiphany when understanding emerged gradually.
Do not turn a retrospective into a numbered lesson list.
End with an earned observation, not generic advice.
Allow unresolved or imperfect details when they are honest.
Vary narrative devices across posts instead of reskinning the best-performing hook.

avoid: Automatic 'gue kira X, ternyata Y' openings
Time-marker openings reused only because they performed before
Trailer fragments such as 'Dashboard hidup. Sistem shipped. Client happy.'
A hook that contains metrics without human meaning
available_devices: A real object carrying the story
An inventory with one important missing element
A counterfactual about what Abdiel would do differently
Two interpretations of the same event
A quiet contradiction embedded inside a longer sentence
hook_guidance.selection_rule: Choose the device that best expresses the specific experience. Do not choose solely from historical engagement data.

technical_writing.principle: Technical terms should explain stakes, decisions, or constraints. They should not function as a credibility inventory.
include: Specific models, tools, metrics, or system behavior when they materially explain what changed
One plain-language explanation before dense mechanics
The difference between what Abdiel's team built and what a client supplied
avoid: Listing every component in the architecture
Presenting a system-level result as if one model caused it
Inventing confidence or causal explanations not supported by evidence

client_safe_writing: Separate internal labels from public descriptions.
Use anonymized descriptions such as 'client dari Prancis' when requested.
Do not publish ratings, private communication, credentials, private repositories, internal folder paths, or proprietary data.
Share responsibility fairly when the handoff and Abdiel's own preflight were both incomplete.
Frame accepted handoff to another developer as normal project completion unless evidence supports another interpretation.

visual_style.principle: Use the real artifact that carries or proves the story.
preferred: A handoff or acceptance artifact when public
avoid: Dense screenshots that cannot be read on mobile
Symbolic images that dramatize without proving
Memes that become more memorable than the work

style_checks_before_delivery: Would Abdiel say this sentence aloud?
Does the opening sound like a person recounting something or a copywriter manufacturing a hook?
Did we overfit to one of Abdiel's successful posts?
Is the personal observation specific to Abdiel?
Does each technical detail earn its place?
Did we preserve informal wording instead of cleaning away the personality?
Did we avoid unnecessary dashes and em dashes?
Did we keep one dominant story?
